title: Legendária engine config
description: Engine settings. Put only the keys you want to change in your user config.json (see `flosub config path`).

model.description: Model name from models.json (e.g. small, medium, large-v3-turbo) or a path to a CTranslate2 model folder.

language.description: Speech language code (pt, en, es, ...) or 'auto' to detect it.

device.description: 'auto' uses an NVIDIA GPU when available, otherwise the CPU.

beam_size.description: Beam search width: higher is slightly more accurate and slower.

vad_filter.description: Skip silent parts with voice activity detection (reduces made-up text).

word_timestamps.description: Record the timing of every word (needed for CapCut-style captions).

ui_languages.description: Languages offered in the Blender add-on's language menu.

style.description: Style used by `flosub transcribe`/`export` when --style is not given (a key of 'styles').

styles.description: Cue styles: how words are grouped into on-screen text. 'pop' = one word at a time (two when the first is very short), for pop animations; 'captions' = short CapCut-style phrases (Blender default); 'subtitles' = film-style lines (SRT/VTT default). Add your own.

line_length.description: SRT/VTT: wrap cues longer than this into two lines.

max_duration.description: Longest time (s) a cue may cover.

min_duration.description: Shortest time (s) a cue stays on screen (stretched without overlapping the next).

pause_break.description: A silence longer than this (s) starts a new cue.

break_after.description: Punctuation characters that end a cue.

break_on_segment.description: Start a new cue at each Whisper segment.

join_short.description: A single word with at most this many letters ("a", "de", "no") may take the next word, even beyond max_words.

fill_gaps.description: Extend a cue to the next one when the silence between them is at most this many seconds (avoids blinking).

ass.description: Look of this style in .ass files (burn-in, overlay, exact preview in Blender). Sizes are for a 1080 px video (the shorter side) and scale with it. Colors are RGBA from 0 to 1.

font.description: Font family name (the system's fallback is used when it is missing).

outline.description: Outline width in pixels (box padding when 'box' is true).

box.description: Opaque box behind the text instead of an outline.

position.description: Center of the text: [x from the left, y from the bottom], 0 to 1.

width.description: Widest a line may get, as a fraction of the video width.

animation.description: Entrance animation: {'type': 'none'} or {'type': 'pop', 'from': 70, 'peak': 112, 'peak_ms': 90, 'ms': 170} (scale in %, times in ms).

mode.description: suggest: write <name>.review.json for the user to accept; auto: apply corrections directly.

glossary_bias.description: Pass glossary terms to Whisper as hotwords while transcribing.

fuzzy_threshold.description: How similar an uncertain word must be to a glossary term to suggest it (0.5–1).

low_confidence.description: Words below this Whisper confidence are checked against the glossary.

profile.description: light/standard: glossary only (no LLM, for weak or CPU-only devices); full: glossary + LLM; auto: use the LLM when enabled and reachable.

llm.description: EXPERIMENTAL LLM reviewer (layer 3): any OpenAI-compatible chat server. Off by default; enable it here or with `flosub review --llm`.

enabled.description: false (default): off; true: always; auto: use it when the server answers. Experimental.

provider.description: A key of providers.json: ollama, lmstudio, llamacpp, openai, gemini, anthropic, openrouter, or your own.

base_url.description: Override the provider's URL (empty = provider default).

model.description: Model id (empty = first chat model the server lists).

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key (keys are never stored in files).

max_change_ratio.description: Lines changed more than this are treated as rewrites and ignored.

unload_after.description: Ollama: free the model from GPU memory after the review.

glossary.description: Active glossary of the library (<config dir>/glossaries/<name>.txt). Change it with `flosub glossary use NAME`.

ffmpeg.description: Path to ffmpeg (or its folder) for burn-in and overlays. Empty: look on PATH.
